name: Theme Song Volume
overview: [PREVIEW] Keep library theme songs at a comfortable volume.
description: [PREVIEW] Set a default theme-song volume and individual song overrides without changing source files or normal playback volume. Settings follow your Jellyfin account. Requires File Transformation 3.x and a compatible server-hosted Jellyfin Web client.
